Results.ReviewText: This grill is very forgiving, produces great grill marks without torching food items, and goes fairly easy on the propane tank.  There is sufficient room to make kabobs on one side and grilled flatbread on the other for a party of 6.  The grates are massively hunky duty and work really well.  I choose NOT to burn them off to conserve propane but the "green scrubby" brush works really well in the kitchen sink.  I have been using this grill for most of our meals to keep the cooking heat outside.  So far I've grilled burgers/dogs/sausages, various chops and kabobs, steak, chicken, stuffed bell peppers and sundry veggies.  All have turned out well.
Results.Title: Great 2-Burner Grill

44010001.Name: Spirit II E-210 Gas Grill (Liquid Propane)
44010001.Description:
Open the door to the world of grilling with crazy good food and friends coming together. Equipped with the powerful GS4 grilling system, this two burner gas grill is your entry to the Weber family and to everyday grilling. The compact open-cart design and the practical folding side table makes it fit even on small spaces, and you have all the basics you need to get familiar with gas grilling. So whether it’s a busy Monday or a relaxed Sunday – invite a couple of friends over, push the ignition and enjoy the special atmosphere that surrounds the grill.


 This product requires assembly.
